items.title: Vistra Has Slumped for a Year: Why Morgan Stanley Still Sees 82% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley cut its Vistra price target to $211 from $224 and kept its Overweight rating, which still points to 82% upside. Vistra fell on cheaper Texas power and an election that put data center growth in doubt, and Constellation Energy and NRG Energy are down sharply too, even though both held or raised guidance.

items.title: How Has Vistra Stock's Story Changed?
items.summary: Vistra stock closed at $123.87 on Monday, November 23. At that price, you pay 7.2 times the cash its operations brought in over the past year. The S&P 500 as a whole trades at 14.8 times on the same measure. Anyone paying that price should know which business management now asks them to own.
